### Summary

The source of kintera is organized by topic, and so is this report. This section sends a reader from a
question, or from a directory of the code, to the chapter and section that answers it. Each chapter opens with its
own scheme table, which lists its sections with their options, defaults and tests.

::: {.callout-note title="At a glance"}
**Purpose.** A route from a topic or a source directory to its chapter.

**Data.** The chapter list below; the topic index (@sec-appf) and the task map (@sec-appg) give finer routes.

**Placement.** Read first.

**Activation.** Not applicable: this is a reading guide.

**Guarantee / limits.** Points to chapters and sections only; their content is not restated.

**Evidence.** Not applicable; see the Tests layer.
:::

| chapter | look here for | main source |
|---|---|---|
| @sec-ch01b | what each solver holds fixed; the shared saturation and energy functions | `src/thermo/`, `src/kinetics/` |
| @sec-ch02 | species, molar masses, NASA-9 data, vapour pressure | `src/species.*`, `src/vapors/` |
| @sec-ch03 | equation of state, thermodynamic functions, adiabats | `src/thermo/` |
| @sec-ch04 | saturation adjustment of several condensables | `src/thermo/equilibrate_*` |
| @sec-ch05 | multiphase chemical equilibrium (the log-K solver) | `src/equilibrium/` |
| @sec-ch06 | reactions, rate constants, Jacobian, implicit step | `src/kinetics/` |
| @sec-ch07 | cross sections, actinic flux, photolysis rates | `src/photochem/` |
| @sec-ch08 | vertical eddy diffusion | `src/diffusion/` |
| @sec-ch09 | the two-dimensional atmosphere solver | `python/atm2d/` |
| @sec-ch10 | linear algebra, constrained least squares, interpolation | `src/math/` |
| @sec-ch11 | YAML input, options objects, Python bindings | `src/utils/`, `python/csrc/` |
| @sec-ch12 | CPU and CUDA execution | `src/loops.cuh`, dispatch files |
| @sec-ch13 | test suite and validation cases | `tests/` |
| @sec-ch14 | how snapy and paddle call kintera | other repositories |

: Chapters of the report and the code they describe. {#tbl-ch01-map-chapters}

The table points to chapter labels; each chapter's own scheme table lists its sections. The library is built from
the directories that `src/CMakeLists.txt` lists ({{< code src/CMakeLists.txt >}}). The Python package re-exports the
compiled module and adds the `atm2d`, `equilibrium` and `kinetics_base_titan` subpackages
({{< code python/__init__.py >}}).
